Definition: genitive case of G2500; Jose, an Israelite:--Jose.
BiblicalUsage: Jose is the name Luke gives to one ancestor of Jesus, in the genealogy that runs back to Adam. In Luke 3:29 the line runs through Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, and the Greek text writes his name with the same letters as the name Jesus, which is why the old copies spell it Jose here and Jesus elsewhere.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jose is a reminder that the genealogy is made of real men with shared names: this Jose is not the Lord, he is one more link in the Lord's line.
